Step 1 AM Routine: Apply cream on the clean pigmented areas - elbow, neck, knees post shower Step 2 PM Routine: Glide stick onto the clean skin with bumps / ingrown hair / rough texture / strawberry skin before bed Step 3 Use it consistently for 3 months for visible results Important Information We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction. Follow the following steps for a patch test: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product Is it right for you? Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Body Exfoliation & Pigmentation Kit How do I use this kit? We recommend you to use your Pigmentation Repair Cream in your AM routine to target pigmentation/discolouration around elbows, neck & knees and the Glycolic Acid Stick and in your PM routine as a hydrating exfoliator for strawberry/chicken skin and KP (Keratosis Pilaris) bumps. What are the side effects of this kit? There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you to do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time. How much time will it take to see results? You should notice visible reduction in bumps/strawberry skin & pigmentation with 3 months of use. For severe pigmentation: changes depend on the severity of the condition. We recommend speaking to an expert for your speicific case. Is it suitable for sensitive skin? Yes, both products are Paraben, Sulphate & Phthalate-free. However, do a patch test before first use and introduce gradually if you have sensitive skin. Can I use these products directly post-waxing/shaving? We'd suggest keeping a gap of 6-12 hours to use these products post waxing/shaving. Can I use this product on my face? This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial moisturisation. How long should we keep the Pigmentation Repair cream after applying it ? This is a leave in formulation, hence we do not recommend washing this cream post application. Keep it as long as possible and wait for the cream to absorb.
